test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The minute hand of a large wall clock is 63 cm long. Using pi = (22)/(7) , find the length of the arc (in cm) traced by the tip of the minute hand in 11 seconds.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered by tip in 1 hour (3600s) = 2 × 22/7 × 63 = 396 cm.

Speed of minute hand tip = 396 ÷ 3600 = 0.11 cm/s.

Arc length in 11 seconds = 0.11 × 11 = 1.21 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.21 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of minute hand (r) = 63 cm

Time duration (t) = 11 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Arc Length = (Time ÷ Total Time for 1 rotation) × 2 × π × r

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8ecd22204eb42b93e7056802386da5d80711964f47892fd9f7110f07e99f94.png] 

⇒ Total time for minute hand to complete 1 revolution = 60 minutes = 3600 seconds

⇒ Circumference of the path = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 63

⇒ Circumference = 2 × 22 × 9 = 396 cm

⇒ Arc length in 11 seconds = (11 ÷ 3600) × 396

⇒ Arc length = (11 × 396) ÷ 3600

⇒ Arc length = 4356 ÷ 3600

⇒ Arc length = 1.21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 1.21 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angular speed of hands

The minute hand covers 6° per minute (360° ÷ 60), and the hour hand covers 0.5° per minute (30° ÷ 60).

Arc length and Sector area

For a circle of radius r and central angle θ (in degrees), Arc Length = (θ ÷ 360) × 2πr and Area of Sector = (θ ÷ 360) × πr².

Relative speed of hands

The relative angular speed between the minute hand and the hour hand is 5.5° per minute (6° − 0.5°).</p
